title: 2009 HMMT November Guts Problem 6
statement: Find the last two digits of \(1032^{1032}\). Express your answer as a two-digit number.

solutions.text:
76 The last two digits of \(1032^{1032}\) is the same as the last two digits of \(32^{1032}\). The last two digits of \(32^{n}\) repeat with a period of four as \(32,24,68,76,32,24,68,76, \ldots\).
\(2^{\text {nd }}\) ANNUAL HARVARD-MIT NOVEMBER TOURNAMENT, 7 NOVEMBER 2009 - GUTS ROUND
